## Problem

Describe the user-visible problem and why it belongs in Frame Quorum.

## Change

Explain the smallest behavior change, including manifest compatibility.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest --cov`
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a deterministic synthetic test
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior is user-visible
- [ ] I reviewed and understand every submitted line and disclosed material tooling assistance

## Evidence

Include relevant command output or a reproducible synthetic fixture. Do not upload confidential images.
